title: feat(nstri): three-site opposite-lock unique vector: reverse fails, face UNDEFINED
science: Three-site opposite-lock seed {0,(0,1,0),(1,0,0)} with locks +e_1,-e_1,+e_2, neighbour-lock vector readout on x-probes. Two defects: it runs a REDUCED checker (16 checks, 6 of them prose greps, no mutation or cross-route tests, no cache_write declaration) versus 41-63 elsewhere; and its `already_recorded_neighbors` switches from strictly-earlier to same-tick-inclusive when the probe forms at tick 0, which is the only reason L(A)=+e_1 is defined and reverse reads `fail` instead of `UNDEFINED`.
